title: Make warning-severity alert delivery explicit in the VMAlertmanagerConfig
description: Only severity=critical + environment=production has a matching sub-route today; disk.yaml/longhorn-backup.yaml fire severity=warning rules whose delivery is not established (may be firing into the void). Add an explicit severity=warning → discord sub-route in the VMAlertmanagerConfig.
notes: EVIDENCE 2026-10-15: chart edit b413c1ff adds explicit severity=warning+environment=production sub-route with continue=false to the discord receiver; ArgoCD synced at b413c1ff2; operator re-render confirmed the warning matcher in the live rendered config. Synthetic alert TkFahSyntheticWarning with severity=warning POSTed at 22:22:25Z was recorded by alertmanager as dispatched to monitoring-alertmanager-config-discord; discord notifications counter rose 112 to 122 in the window with zero failed notifications. Warnings previously only reached discord via implicit fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic severity=warning alert delivered to Discord.
